_comment: Open Mirroring targets — push source tables into a Fabric Open Mirroring landing zone. Place as config.open_mirror.json (gitignored). Each target binds to an EXISTING source connection id from config.connection.json via 'connection' (default: 'default'); the source database engine is unchanged. 'landing_zone_root' is the mirrored database's OneLake landing zone (or a local staging directory for now). See https://learn.microsoft.com/fabric/mirroring/open-mirroring-landing-zone-format and devplan/Open_Mirroring_Integration_Plan.md.
